seoTitle: Hours and Minutes to Decimal Hours Converter for Billing
metaDescription: Convert 2:45 to 2.75 hours and back, with optional round-up to billing increments. Free.
intro: Converts hours and minutes (2:45 or 2h 45m) to decimal hours and decimal hours to hours and minutes, with a total and optional rounding up.
why:
Timesheets and invoices need decimal hours: 2 hours 45 minutes is 2.75, not 2.45. The mistake is common.

List several times to get a total. Set a round-up step such as 6 or 15 minutes if you bill in increments.
howTo: Optionally set a round-up step in minutes.

faq.a: Lines with a colon or h and m become decimals; plain numbers become h:mm.
Yes, always up to the next step, as most billing does.
